The agreed follow-up is to prepare the care-cost cash-flow projection by 2026-08-29."}, {"title": "Address benefit changes from reduced work", "text": "Address the impact on the monthly care budget and estimated tax payments if Nadia Pebblefizz’s consulting income of $2,100 per month stops due to caregiving demands.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-09-11", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Nadia’s consulting income may stop if caregiving demands continue, and she asked how losing that income would affect the monthly care budget and estimated tax payments; the agreed follow-up is to address benefit changes from reduced work by 2026-09-11."}, {"title": "Prepare respite placement decision support", "text": "Prepare a financial comparison of Thimble Harbor Assisted Living respite suite versus expanded in-home shifts for the family’s decision-making.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-08-26", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Thimble Harbor Assisted Living is holding a respite suite only briefly, and the family wants a financial comparison with expanded in-home shifts before responding; the agreed follow-up is to prepare respite placement decision support by 2026-08-26."}, {"title": "Provide information for tax estimate of medical and caregiver costs", "text": "Provide the projected home-care, adult day, respite, mileage, and caregiver-payment amounts to Jasper Copperwisp of Pocket Lantern Tax Partners for the 2025 federal tax return year-end tax planning.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-09-08", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The family wants the CPA to see projected home-care, adult day, respite, mileage, and caregiver-payment amounts before year-end tax planning assumptions are updated; the agreed follow-up is to provide information for the tax estimate for medical and caregiver costs by 2026-09-08."}]}
